top_signals.title: Bonds Slide Amid Inflation Concerns as Oil Rises on Hormuz Deal Outlook | Bloomberg Brief 08/11/2026
top_signals.summary: Treasuries fall and US equity futures waver as rising oil prices stoke inflation fears. President Trump hardens his stance toward Iran with new demands, clouding the prospect of an immediate agreement on the Strait of Hormuz. AI financing picks up as Nvidia taps investment giants including Apollo and Blackstone to source $500 billion for AI infrastructure. Intel raises $20 billion in an upsized share sale. Laura Cooper of Nuveen discusses the rise in real yields. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: OPEC Output Climbs Again, But Still Trails Quota Targets
top_signals.summary: OPEC’s total oil production jumped by 1.17 million barrels per day in July from June as many Gulf producers restored some output that was shut in for three months due to the closed Strait of Hormuz. Output at the 11-member OPEC rose to 19.85 million bpd in July, extending the monthly increases for the second consecutive month, according to a Reuters survey based on ship-tracking data and information provided by sources at OPEC, oil companies, and consultants. top_signals.title: Libya Weighs Force Majeure After Drone Attacks on Zawiya Oil Hub
top_signals.summary: Libya’s National Oil Corporation may declare force majeure on exports from the Zawya oil terminal as a result of drone attacks on the facility. The Zawya terminal has a daily capacity of 120,000 barrels, sourced from the country’s largest oil field, Sharara, which can produce up to 300,000 barrels daily, Reuters noted in a report on the possibility of a force majeure declaration. top_signals.summary: Trading platform eToro will acquire TradeZero as part of its US expansion as it reported crypto-related revenue fell by about 30% compared to the second quarter of 2025.
